# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment to write based on current state |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with retries |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase using LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for containerised tests |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | Generates TypeScript code for TDD phases |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Drives multi-candidate blind build for one feature |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates TDD across multiple languages |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances per language |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent.py | Extracts Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks generated code for forbidden imports |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook creation, updates, merging, and retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN clustering for playbook bullets |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD and ML experiments to database |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval for code generation |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ retrieve-rank-reason pipeline |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified interface for multiple LLM providers |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Generates embeddings for playbook bullets |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Extracts performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main (run_cycle)
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    loop For each cycle (max 12)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner

        alt Redundant test
            Runner->>Runner: _redundancy_skip()
        else Proceed
            Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
            activate Cycle

            Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: response
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: test_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
            deactivate Container
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
            deactivate Pod

            alt Red aborted or failed
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult (error)
            else Red passed
                loop max_green_attempts
                    Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                    activate Pod
                    Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
                    activate Worker
                    Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                    activate LLM
                    LLM-->>Worker: response
                    deactivate LLM
                    Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                    deactivate Worker
                    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                    activate Orchestrator
                    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                    activate Container
                    Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                    deactivate Container
                    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                    deactivate Orchestrator
                    Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                    deactivate Pod
                    alt Green passed
                        break
                    else Green failed
                        Cycle->>Cycle: update error_feedback
                    end
                end

                alt Green passed
                    Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                    activate Pod
                    Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                    activate Worker
                    Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                    activate LLM
                    LLM-->>Worker: response
                    deactivate LLM
                    Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
                    deactivate Worker
                    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                    activate Orchestrator
                    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                    deactivate Orchestrator
                    Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                    deactivate Pod

                    alt Learning enabled
                        Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, output, feedback)
                        activate Reflector
                        Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                        deactivate Reflector
                        Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                        activate Curator
                        Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                        deactivate Curator
                        Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                        activate Playbook
                        Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullets
                        deactivate Playbook
                    end
                end
            end

            Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
            activate Logger
            Logger-->>Cycle: ok
            deactivate Logger
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
            deactivate Cycle
        end

        alt Planner says COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end
    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
